Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Langwarrin South

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Langwarrin South. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Langwarrin South, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Langwarrin South: What We Commonly See

Langwarrin South is a semi-rural, rural-residential pocket of larger, treed blocks, with homes set among paddocks, sheds and outbuildings. Roofs here are a mix of older roofing on established homes and COLORBOND® and other metal on newer homes, sheds and farm buildings.

The mature trees that give the area its character drop a lot of leaves and bark into gutters and valleys, and larger metal roofs and sheds need their own attention. The jobs we are called out for most in Langwarrin South are clearing and replacing gutters and valleys, refixing ridge capping, and re-sheeting or replacing rusted shed and home metal roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Langwarrin South

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Langwarrin South homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Langwarrin South

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Langwarrin South

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Langwarrin South Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Langwarrin South Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Langwarrin South locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Langwarrin South Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
